chunks: And from him, from al-Naḍr, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Sinān, from Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about salat (prayer) in churches, synagogues, and the houses of the Magians, so he said: “Sprinkle water and pray.”

key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: salat (prayer), the ritual worship being asked about
key_terms.الْبِيَعِ: churches or Christian places of worship
key_terms.الْكَنَائِسِ: synagogues or religious houses of worship

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat (prayer) in churches, synagogues, or the houses of the Magians?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding performing salat (prayer) in places such as churches, synagogues, and the houses of the Magians. The Imam عليه السلام instructs that one should sprinkle water and then pray, indicating a practical ruling related to the place of prayer.
